subject: DArT  Plate #  - possible to access this info from the genlight object?

messages.author: 722521532a54784f
messages.subject: DArT  Plate #  - possible to access this info from the genlight object?
parts:
Hi,
I am importing a new DArT-seq dataset into R and I just read in the function "gl.read.dart" and I read in the dartR manual that you can specify the row number of the Plate # of each sample:

plate_row = The row number in which the information of the plate location is contained [default 3].


In fact, if I open the .csv file from DArT, I can see this information in row # 3.

Is this information available in the genlight object? I don't seem able to find it...it would be good to have the possibility to use this information after the filtering, to cluster by plate# and see if there is any batch/plate effect (see OLeary et al., 2018. These aren’t the loci you’re looking for- Principles of effective SNP filtering for molecular ecologists: https://doi.org/10.1111/mec.14792).

Thanks!
Gabriella

messages.author: 592079bda2cb3220
messages.subject: Re: DArT Plate # - possible to access this info from the genlight object?
parts:
Hi Gabriella,

You can find that information in the slot $other$ind.metrics:

> your_genlight$other$ind.metrics

I'll answer your other questions ASAP.

Cheers,
Luis
